warnings: Maximum calendar gap between trading days is 7 days (e.g. holidays or closures).
notes: Data downloaded via yfinance API from Yahoo Finance.
Historical prices represent unverified consolidated tape data, not exchange-cleared point-in-time ticks.
Adjusted prices account for standard splits and cash dividends according to Yahoo Finance adjustments.

limitations_and_provenance.survivorship_bias: Not applicable to SPY index ETF, but historical index constituents change over time.
limitations_and_provenance.dividend_handling: Adj Close adjusted retroactively for splits and dividends.
